results.title: Night King Director’s Cut
results.overview: The long-awaited director’s cut, with 30 minutes of unrevealed and breathtaking highlights!  The year is 2012. The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club’s manager, Foon (Dayo Wong), despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades.  To make things worse for Foon, the club’s new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife, Madame V (Sammi Cheng)! Determined to change things up, she leaves Foon and his hostesses with no choice but to transform and modernize in order to breathe new life into their business. Little do they know, a powerful conglomerate has been pulling the strings all along to shut down Club EJ for good.  To save their neon empire, Foon and V must join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom.

results.title: Cunning Folk
results.overview: A father brings home an unusual dagger, intending to end the suffering of his gravely ill son.

results.title: Age Perfect
results.overview: A video essay that playfully uses performance-based methods of re-enactment to attempt to enter the frame and material conditions of anti-aging cream commercials and other beauty ads to critique their construction while showcasing their artifice.

results.title: Deep Dive
results.overview: After her family is murdered, a champion swimmer infiltrates the killer's home-ready to drown his world in vengeance.

results.title: Love Oh Love
results.overview: A couple is in love. One partner's excessive spending pushes the other into debt. When the burdened partner decides to seek a divorce, the other files a police complaint through the leader of a women's association. As they begin living together, they gradually understand each other's struggles. Eventually, they reconcile and choose to continue their life together.

results.title: Mi vecina la buchona
results.overview: A federal agent moves to a town controlled by organized crime to keep an eye on a feared hitman. Getting too close to her target could jeopardize the entire mission.

results.title: Tristán and the Days to Come
results.original_title: Tristán y los días por venir
results.overview: Tristán is navigating his teenage years in an exceptional way: navigating his gender transition alongside his mum Virginia, his friends, his school and the Argentine State, whilst discovering his passion for drawing. But when the pressures of adulthood begin to mount and a shift in the political landscape threatens his rights, he is faced with a question: is it possible to be trans without suffering so much?

results.title: Bhamardo
results.overview: Two village boys dream of winning a medical scholarship and bicycle. They enter a spinning top tournament, taking on odd jobs and seeking mentors to master their skills and bring honor to their community.

results.title: Heat of Madness
results.overview: On the verge of becoming a father, Scola is hoping to make it big with one final heist. However, betrayed by his accomplices and blinded by the obsession to recover his loot, he embarks on a vengeful quest that leads him into a supernatural world.

results.title: Weekend Warrior
results.overview: Tess goes to a Larp and transforms herself into the Elf General Tauriel. When her foot soldier is wounded in a fight with orcs she heals him with a magic balm, which gives the weekend war games an unexpected erotic turn.

results.title: The Ocean and the Sea
results.overview: A man's relationship with his wife - and himself - changes when he encounters a mysterious stranger adrift at sea.

results.title: When The Bell Rings
results.overview: After years of pain, sacrifice, and relentless training, young wrestler Eli Knight chases the moment that could change his life forever.

results.title: I'm not crazy. Maybe a little...
results.overview: A desperate middle-aged alcoholic and a heartbroken young woman escape from a psychiatric hospital and embark on an absurd journey through the nighttime streets of Riga to save a cat and, perhaps, themselves as well.

results.title: Les monstres
results.overview: Car broken down, a couple dreads the monsters lurking in the night.

results.title: Billy Idol Should Be Dead
results.overview: Punk legend turned pop sensation Billy Idol bares it all in this electrifying documentary, revealing his rise to fame, battle with addiction and triumphant comeback that captivated millions of fans worldwide.

results.title: The Hidden Face of the Earth
results.original_title: La face cachée de la Terre
results.overview: Dimitri loves photographing friends, strangers, lovers. Over the years, images have slipped away from his sight. Behind his camera, he gathers light and bodies, inviting us to gaze toward the hidden face of the Earth.

results.title: Violet After the Storm
results.overview: In 1959 Violet Kingston, a mother of eight, contends with the loss of her husband in one of the worst fishing disasters in New Brunswick history.

results.title: Pelvic Dream
results.overview: After being diagnosed with pelvic contracture, Maga begins treatment with a physical therapist who is secretly an apprentice dominatrix. The encounter leads to a night where roles are blurred and both transform their relationship and those around them.

results.title: Puuluup: Cables in the Car
results.overview: Puuluup: Cables in the Car, Still is a humorous and poetic music documentary about two middle-aged musicians who are bringing the long-forgotten Talharpa to world stages. Dry humor, absurd situations, and "neo-zombie-post-folk" music intertwine in a portrait where the glory of the stage clashes with everyday life and fatherhood. The film proves that late success can be the sweetest.

results.title: She Cries Murder
results.overview: Follows two brother private detectives as they solve the murder of a woman's husband. A case that was concluded as a suicide by local police.
